**THERE IS NO 3X3 AT THIS COMPETITION!**
This competition includes only blindfolded events and clock. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.

venue.name: University of Western Ontario [University Community Centre](https://wts.uwo.ca/ctg/classrooms/university_community_centre/index.html)
venue.details: Mustang Lounge on the main floor

items.information:
## London Winter 2023 Series

The London Winter 2023 Series is a collaboration between the **Western University Cube Club** and **Speedcubing Canada**.  

This competition is in a series with [London Winter A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LondonWinterA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

Speedcubing Canada is aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Please read all the above tabs before registering, especially Covid-19 Safety and Competitor Info.**

* **The registration fee of $25.00 will be paid in cash on the day of the competition.**
* **If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please email the organizers to cancel your registration.**

- Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
- Proceeds from this competition will go toward Cube New England and the Smith College Trans and Non-Binary Alliance.
